title: Paper Temporary Driver's Licenses on Wayfare Agreements: Driver Upload Tool Reference
content:
Under the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product, a Wayfare driver who has renewed a driver's license and holds the paper temporary license issued on renewal may ask to have it accepted as the driver's license on file.

## The rule

A paper temporary driver's license issued on renewal is accepted as the driver's license on file for its temporary license acceptance days, counted in calendar days from the day the driver uploads it. The upload puts the temporary license on the standing record with an expiry date of the upload day plus the temporary license acceptance days, and the driver's license expiry date on the agreement becomes that same date.

## Conditions on working out the days

The temporary license acceptance days are not worked out until the auto insurance expiry date on the agreement carries the accepted period of every insurance binder uploaded to the standing record.

Before the temporary license acceptance days are worked out, the agreement's status must already show the deactivation for document lapse owed by any document hold that has run past its lapse allowance.

Both conditions concern the agreement's own records as they stand when the days are worked out: its auto insurance expiry date, and its status.

## The upload tool and who runs it

The upload is the driver's own act. It is made with the customer tool `upload_temporary_license_ef094b46`: the support agent unlocks the tool and hands it over, and the customer themselves (the driver) runs it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `driver_agreement_id` | the reference number of the driver's own services agreement, as read out by the support agent from the driver agreement lookup | identifier, as shown |
| `accepted_days` | the accepted period of the temporary license, as given by the support agent | a whole number of calendar days counted from today: integer, no decimals, no unit text |

One run adds a document upload to the driver's standing record, of document type `drivers_license`, dated today, with an expiry date of today plus `accepted_days` calendar days, and sets the license expiry date on the driver services agreement to that same date.

## Receipt

The tool returns a dictionary receipt with `upload_reference` (the reference number of the new standing record entry), `driver_agreement_id`, `document_type` (`drivers_license`), `license_expiry_date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, the license expiry date now on file) and `uploaded_on` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, today's date). A receipt with an `upload_reference` means the temporary license is on file. The tool's contract defines no other outcome.

Hypothetical illustration: run on 2026-08-10 with `accepted_days` of `22`, the receipt shows a `license_expiry_date` of `2026-09-01`.
